g.text: cmd: gh issue view N | pass: body contains an Acceptance line with a command and expected output
cmd: git switch -c type/short-name | pass: git branch --show-current prints the name
cmd: gh pr create | pass: prints the PR URL; body quotes verbatim evidence
cmd: gh pr checks N | pass: no line reads pending or fail
cmd: gh pr checks N | pass: a check failed; fix the cause, push again
cmd: gh pr merge N --merge | pass: gh pr view N --json state prints MERGED
cmd: git pull --ff-only | pass: git status -sb shows main...origin/main with no ahead or behind
cmd: gh issue close N | pass: acceptance output quoted in the issue first
